data.description: Abu Dhabi's centre of gravity - a prestigious waterfront address designed for luxury living.

data.answer: Al Maryah Island offers a lifestyle defined by sophistication and effortless convenience. Residents enjoy access to world-class amenities, including luxury retail at The Galleria, a striking waterfront promenade, gourmet restaurants, and beautifully landscaped parks. The island's well-planned infrastructure ensures a high standard of living, supported by exceptional residential and commercial facilities. Its upscale ambiance and family-friendly environment make it a highly sought-after destination in the capital.

Al Maryah Island, Abu Dhabi, features a diverse portfolio of properties. This comprises apartments and penthouses, townhouses, villas, offices, and shops. Designed with modern aesthetics and built to the highest standards, these properties offer elegant interiors and premium facilities. Whether for living or investment, they provide excellent value and exceptional appeal.

Off-Plan Projects in Al Maryah Island

St. Regis Residences

St. Regis Residences Al Maryah Island by SAAS Properties redefines luxury waterfront living in Abu Dhabi's most prestigious district. The branded residences feature 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, duplexes, and penthouses with panoramic views and refined interiors, plus world-class amenities and direct access to The Galleria, Zuma, COYA and the Louvre Abu Dhabi. 

Four Seasons Private Residences

Developed by Mubadala, Four Seasons Private Residences is an exclusive collection of 124 waterfront homes ranging from 1 to 3-bedroom apartments to duplexes and penthouses. The residences are designed to the highest standards and elevated by bespoke Four Seasons service.

W Residences

Developed by Taraf Holding in partnership with Marriott International, W Residences is a 37-storey branded landmark offering 177 limited residences across 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, 4-bedroom duplexes, and 5-bedroom penthouses. Inspired by the graceful lines of traditional dhow boats, the project blends W Hotels' signature style with sweeping skyline views and seamless connectivity to Abu Dhabi's business district.

Vista 2

Vista 2 by Reportage Properties is an upscale residential development at Al Maryah Island, Abu Dhabi, offering studios and 1 to 4-bedroom apartments alongside premium retail shops. Set in the heart of an international financial free zone, the project places residents along Abu Dhabi's longest canal with views of gleaming white yachts and easy access to a vibrant, resort-like community, making it an exceptional opportunity for both living and investment.

Renting a Property in Al Maryah Island

Properties for rent in Al Maryah Island include studio to 6-bedroom apartments and 4 to 6-bedroom penthouses, alongside villas, townhouses, offices, and shops. These properties for rent in Abu Dhabi offer residents modern conveniences and luxury finishes, with access to exceptional amenities, making the island a preferred rental location.

Buying a Property in Al Maryah Island

Properties for sale in Al Maryah Island include studios and 1 to 6-bedroom apartments, alongside penthouses, townhouses, villas, offices, and shops. These properties for sale in Abu Dhabi are ideal for those seeking a blend of comfort and exclusivity with strong investment potential in a centrally located luxury community.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Al Maryah Island?

data.answer:
Life on Al Maryah Island offers the perfect balance of elegance and accessibility. The central Al Maryah Island location in Abu Dhabi ensures proximity to major business hubs and cultural landmarks. Residents enjoy seamless access to luxury retail and fine dining, alongside wellness facilities, waterfront promenades, and lush green spaces, making it one of the most desirable places to live in the capital.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Al Maryah Island

Al Maryah Island is well connected to the rest of Abu Dhabi through a network of bridges and major roads, offering effortless access to neighboring districts. The island is also served by Abu Dhabi public bus routes 005, 040, and 052, with stops at ADGM Square and Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi. The island provides both private and open parking spaces, ensuring convenience for residents, workers, and visitors alike. Several parking facilities are available throughout the island, enhancing accessibility.

Supermarkets in Al Maryah Island

Waitrose is the primary supermarket on Al Maryah Island, and is in fact the largest Waitrose branch in Abu Dhabi, offering premium grocery selections. Additional supermarkets such as Carrefour Market, SPAR Express, and Lulu Express are available within a short drive on the neighbouring islands, ensuring residents have convenient shopping options.

Shopping Malls in Al Maryah Island

The Galleria Al Maryah Island is a premier lifestyle destination offering luxury retail and fine dining alongside vibrant entertainment options. It is a central attraction for both residents and tourists, enhancing the island's upscale urban appeal.

Schools and Nurseries in Al Maryah Island

While there are no schools on Al Maryah Island itself, a number of well-regarded options are located on adjacent Al Reem Island, just a short drive across the bridge.

Playhouse Nursery on Reem Island is just a short drive from Al Maryah Island and offers early education in a nurturing environment. It provides a range of activities to support child development within a safe and stimulating setting.

Redwood Montessori Nursery (Al Reem Island branch) also lies within a 10-minute drive and focuses on hands-on learning through the Montessori method. Repton School Abu Dhabi, also located on Al Reem Island, offers the British curriculum and state-of-the-art educational facilities, making it a top choice for families living on the island.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and near Al Maryah Island Location

Residents have access to mosques, including Al Aziz Mosque and Sheikh Khalifa Bin Zayed Mosque (Al Bateen), both reachable within 10 minutes, offering spacious prayer areas and community facilities.

For the Hindu community, the BAPS Hindu Mandir in Abu Mureikhah is approximately a 40 to 50 minute drive from the island and serves as a major spiritual and cultural centre for devotees across the UAE.

Christian residents can visit St. Joseph's Cathedral and St. Andrew's Church in Al Mushrif, each about 15 minutes from the island, offering regular services and community activities.

Clinics and Hospitals in and near Al Maryah Island

Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi, located on the island, offers world-class medical care with advanced specialties. Burjeel Hospital on Al Najda Street is approximately 10 to 15 minutes away and complements the healthcare landscape with comprehensive services and a strong reputation for quality.

Al Maryah Island Location & Nearby Areas

The Al Maryah Island location places residents in central Abu Dhabi, surrounded by prominent areas such as Al Zahiyah and Al Reem Island. This central positioning enhances connectivity and access to the city's major business and retail hubs as well as residential districts.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Al Maryah Island

data.answer:
Al Maryah Island offers a variety of leisure experiences, including luxury shopping, waterfront dining, and recreational spaces. The area is well-suited for residents looking to balance relaxation with urban excitement.

Al Maryah Island Attractions and Landmarks

Al Maryah Island Family Park is a lush, landscaped park perfect for families. It features modern playgrounds and shaded walking paths, alongside open lawns and seating areas, creating a welcoming environment for relaxation and leisure.

Al Fay Park, a 9-minute drive from the island, is Abu Dhabi's first urban biodiversity park. It boasts thousands of native trees and shaded walkways, alongside sports courts and fitness areas, offering a green oasis in the city center.

Reem Central Park, a short drive away on the neighbouring Al Reem Island, is a vibrant recreational space with a waterfront promenade. The park also features skate parks and jogging tracks, alongside basketball courts and interactive fountains. Its large green spaces and modern amenities attract families and fitness enthusiasts alike.

Al Maryah Island Restaurants

The island is best known for its award-winning, Michelin-recognized waterfront fine-dining venues. These include Zuma, COYA, Nusr-Et, and LPM Restaurant & Bar, all situated along The Galleria's waterfront promenade. Other notable dining venues at The Galleria include The Cheesecake Factory for American cuisine, Almayass for Lebanese-Armenian flavors, and SushiArt for Japanese dining. Each offers an upscale and diverse culinary experience.

Beaches in Al Maryah Island

Al Maryah Island is bordered by a striking pedestrian promenade and waterfront boardwalk that wraps around the island, offering 360° views of the city skyline and the surrounding waters. While Al Maryah Island does not have a dedicated public beach, residents and visitors can enjoy the boardwalk for leisurely strolls, jogging, and dining at the waterfront restaurants. Private beach access is available to residents and guests of the Four Seasons Hotel and Private Residences. For full beach experiences, nearby Saadiyat Island and the Corniche are easily accessible.

Hotels near Al Maryah Island

Rosewood Abu Dhabi and Four Seasons Hotel Abu Dhabi are two of the island's most prestigious hotels. Both offer luxury accommodations and refined dining, with impeccable services for guests and long-term residents.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Al Maryah Island supports an active lifestyle with jogging paths and open spaces alongside its scenic parks. Residents also have access to well-equipped gyms and a variety of beauty salons and spas, ensuring holistic wellness and relaxation.

Al Maryah Island, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates offers a distinctive living experience with luxurious residences and high-end amenities in a prime central location. The environment is safe and well-maintained, suited to families and professionals alike. Property prices reflect the island's premium positioning as both a luxury lifestyle hub and Abu Dhabi's Central Business District, and prospective buyers or tenants should weigh these costs against their personal lifestyle and investment priorities.

Where is Al Maryah Island located? 

The Al Maryah Island location is in central Abu Dhabi, between Abu Dhabi Island (Al Zahiyah) and Al Reem Island, offering exceptional connectivity and convenience.

What property types are available on Al Maryah Island, Abu Dhabi?

 Al Maryah Island, Abu Dhabi, offers apartments and penthouses, alongside townhouses, villas, offices, and shops, catering to both residential and commercial needs.

Are there luxury hotels on Al Maryah Island, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates? 

Yes, the island features luxury hotels like Rosewood Abu Dhabi and Four Seasons Hotel Abu Dhabi, offering refined hospitality and premium services.

What amenities are found on Al Maryah Island, Abu Dhabi?

 The island is home to The Galleria and luxury dining, alongside scenic parks, fitness centers, world-class healthcare at Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi, and the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) financial free zone, all set against a vibrant waterfront promenade.

Is Al Maryah Island a good place to invest in property? 

Al Maryah Island Abu Dhabi United Arab Emirates offers strong investment potential due to its prime location and freehold ownership rights for foreign investors, alongside upscale developments and high demand.

data.content:
Al Maryah Island is a prestigious destination in Abu Dhabi, offering a luxurious blend of residential and commercial life with refined lifestyle experiences. Strategically positioned between Al Zahiyah and Al Reem Island, it is the capital’s Central Business District. The island is home to the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), the emirate's international financial free zone, as well as the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (ADX). 

The Al Maryah Island location ensures excellent connectivity and high desirability among residents and investors. The island features an extensive range of properties. These include upscale apartments and lavish penthouses, elegant townhouses, spacious villas, premium offices, and high-end retail shops. Each development reflects modern architectural excellence, making Al Maryah Island a symbol of refined urban living. It caters to both residents seeking comfort and businesses aiming for prestige.

In December 2025, Aldar and Mubadala announced a major joint-venture expansion on the northern side of the island. The development is set to double the available office space and add around 3,000 luxury waterfront apartments, along with a landmark hotel and three new connecting bridges, further reinforcing the island's status as Abu Dhabi's premier mixed-use destination.
